speaker: Stuart
text: Not just the finger, the moving finger. Oh, hey, Penny. Wow. Hi. Nothing. I'm just getting ready to close up and head out.

text: Hey, Stuart. What's going on?

text: Oh, cool. Got any fun plans?

text: Oh, yeah. Big night tonight. Gonna share a can of tuna with the cat.

text: Oh, nice.

text: Not even my cat. I just feed it. Some nights it doesn't even show up.

text: Oh, okay. Well, I was hoping, um, you could do me a favor. Well, I'm kind of responsible for Sheldon missing Stanley, and I really want to make it up to him. So I was hoping you could give me his phone number so maybe I can arrange for them to meet.

text: Sure, yeah, name it.

text: Oh, I'm sorry, I don't have his phone number.

text: Wait. I have his address. But I can't give it to you.

text: Then why did you tell me you had it?

text: I don't know, just chatting. You're looking at a guy who could very well get stood up by a stray cat tonight.

text: I'm sorry, Stuart. Thanks anyway.

text: Wait. Maybe we can make a deal.

text: Sure, what the hell. We'll tell people he's your cousin. This is Stanley's front door. We were on Stanley's curb, then we were on Stanley's walk, and now we're at Stanley's front door.
